ALL that certain lot, parcel or tract of land, situate and lying in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and State of New Jersey being more particularly described as follows:

Beginning at a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76 where intersected by the Southerly line of Lot 12.09, Block 76, said point being North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West, 101.35 feet from the intersection of said Northeasterly line of Lot 10 with the Southerly line of Lot 12.13, Block 76 and running, thence

(1) Along said Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West, 19.87 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.08 and 12.09 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(2) Along the said division line, North 60 degrees 54 minutes 43 seconds East, 30.33 feet to a point in same; thence

(3) Still along said division line, North 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds East, 57.39 feet to a point in the southwesterly line of Lot 12.03; thence

(4) Along said Southwesterly line of Lot 12.03 and along the Southwesterly line of Lot 12.04, South 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds East, 19.98 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.09 and 12.10 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(5) Along said division line, South 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds West, 86.41 feet to the point and place of beginning.
